items.exampleEn: I listen to music on the bus.
He is a great soccer player.
items.exampleZh: 他是一位很棒的足球員。

items.exampleEn: She is a big movie star.
Can I take a picture of you?
I read the news every morning.

items.audioEn: The news says our team won the game.
items.audioZh: 新聞說我們隊贏了比賽。

items.sentenceEn: The dog can catch the ball.
That singer is a big star in Japan.
items.sentenceZh: 那位歌手在日本是大明星。

items.stemEn: Our team played well and ____ the game.
items.stemZh: 我們隊表現很好，贏了比賽。

items.stemEn: Look here! I want to take a ____ of you.
items.stemZh: 看這裡！我想幫你拍張照。

items.passageEn: Ben loves soccer. He is a player on his school team, and he has a picture of a famous soccer player on his wall. Today, Ben's team plays a big game, and they win! It is on the news that night.
items.passageZh: Ben 很愛足球，他是校隊的球員，他的牆上貼著一位知名足球員的照片。今天 Ben 的隊伍參加一場大比賽，而且贏了！當晚的新聞還報導了這件事。

questions.questionZh: Ben 的牆上貼著誰的照片？

referenceEn: I like to listen to music.
rubricZh: 「聽音樂」用 listen to music（要有 to）
like 後面可接 to＋原形或動名詞（例如 like to listen、like listening）

items.instructionZh: 用 movie 造一個句子，說說你喜歡的電影或你最近看的電影。
referenceEn: I watched a funny movie yesterday.
My favorite movie is about a dog.
rubricZh: 「看電影」可用 watch a movie、see a movie 等
時態配合內容（例如過去的事用過去式 watched）
